title: Compact Kähler surfaces with semipositive anticanonical bundle
summary: We classify compact Kähler surfaces with semipositive anticanonical bundle. In particular, we resolve a question of Demailly--Peternell--Schneider: any blowup of $\mathbb{P}^2$ at 9 points on a smooth cubic has semipositive anticanonical bundle.
